# Raw Block

Raw Block is a Bitcoin exploration and protocol-learning workspace that combines:
- live explorer views (blocks, mempool, fees, miners, network, vitals, decoder)
- educational labs (Script, Taproot, Keys, Hashing, Consensus, Lightning, Scenarios)
- analysis modules (UTXO, forensics, privacy, bridges, incidents, D-Index, graffiti)
- research registries (vulnerabilities, attack models, assumptions, policy vs consensus)
- structured Academy paths and protocol glossary

Primary site: https://www.rawblock.net
Repository: https://github.com/leanlp/rawblock

## Data and source policy
- Primary data comes from Raw Block hosted Bitcoin infrastructure (node/indexers/gateway).
- Some modules may use explicit fallback providers when local data is unavailable.
- UI badges and labels indicate fallback or snapshot status when available.
